combo_label: Farms & Farming × Windmills & Watermills × The Blitz

entries.clue: Steady single note sounded once the raiders had passed over
Corrugated steel arch sunk in the garden and covered over with soil
German air arm whose crews came over by night from September 1940
Ploughed and cropped rather than grazed; the drier east of the country suits it
Gate the miller lifts to send the stream running at his wheel
Small set of vanes at the rear that turns a mill cap into the breeze
One of four on a cow's udder, and the rubber end of a feeding bottle
Buzzing rush of sound as the arms sweep past the tower
Line of cut grass lying just as the mower laid it down
Beasts of the wallow taken collectively, and a word for a nasty person
Rank of white towers on a ridge, feeding the national grid
Child sent from a city to the country with a case and a luggage label
